summary: American Airlines, Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) for a Rule 424(b)(5) takedown under an existing shelf registration, offering $273,912,000 of 2026-2B Pass Through Certificates, Series 2026-2. This is a routine equipment financing transaction: pass-through trusts will issue certificates backed by equipment notes secured by 37 aircraft (Airbus A321neo, A321XLR, A321-200, Boeing 777-300ER, and Embraer E175). Proceeds will initially be held in escrow, then used to acquire equipment notes on a full recourse basis. The Class B certificates rank junior to Class A certificates. Interest is payable semiannually. This is a standard aircraft securitization, not a special-situation event, with no change of control, strategic review, or activist involvement.
